settings.graph: Plain Gabriel graph, no distance cutoff; empty closed diameter disk with radius-squared-relative tolerance 1e-10. Rebuilt on retained villages in each bootstrap. No acoustic information, silent graph completion or travel/water constraints.
settings.ward: Adjacency-constrained Ward minimizes SSE increase among graph-linked groups; unit village weights; cuts follow merge sequence rather than sorting potentially nonmonotone heights.
settings.aggregation: Token medians per speaker/vowel/timepoint, then medians across speakers

modes.movement: 4 differences: 50−20 and 80−50, each with 2 acoustic axes

settings.vowel_clustering: Independent Ward trees for each vowel/method/mode; one pooled SD per axis within vowel; divide concatenation by sqrt(number of temporal vectors); no Procrustes alignment
settings.profile_matching: Gabriel-connected components of exact rows at 9; adjacent-only nested common-core merges at 8..3. Identical labels on the SAME named vowels across ALL members; not pairwise-only thresholding.
settings.merge_priority: More shared named cells, then more boundary edges, then larger combined group, then fixed alphabetical village index and internal IDs. Randomized tie-order audit changes only the final tie criterion.
settings.bootstrap_method: Whole speakers resampled jointly across vowels/timepoints. Incomplete resampled villages omitted for that replicate. Per-vowel clusters and profile hierarchy both refitted. Axis scales and spectral PCA fixed. Label-matched exact-row return; label-invariant group ARI/Jaccard/pair retention conditional on presence.
settings.caution: Categorical compression and prescribed k can create or split profiles; shared-core partitions are greedy and tie-sensitive, not unique optimal regions. Exact-row return is especially stringent over nine cells.
settings.profile_constraint: Connected pieces of exact rows at 9, then adjacent-only common-core merges; priority shared cells, boundary-edge count, combined size, fixed order
